surfaces.label: Microphone permission and lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Permission remains gesture-gated; a late permission result is stopped; active resources are released on stop, failure, interruption, and component teardown.

surfaces.label: Raw signal data handling
surfaces.notes: Frames remain in memory and production source contains no storage or network sink for sensor data.
surfaces.riskArea: Persistence or transmission of raw microphone frames

surfaces.label: Signal evidence integrity
surfaces.notes: Session identity and frame quality gate frequency evidence; errors, interruption, and stop clear current frame and observations.

surfaces.label: Browser error handling
surfaces.notes: Browser exception names map to stable public codes and recovery copy without rendering browser-supplied messages.
surfaces.riskArea: Sensitive detail disclosure and fail-open UI

surfaces.label: Protected runtime and static hosting worker
surfaces.notes: The 28-file runtime lock passes and worker tests reject missing API/write-route fallback while serving static application routes.
surfaces.riskArea: Runtime tampering and unsafe route fallback

surfaces.label: Test fixture and secret boundary
surfaces.notes: Biome and production-boundary tests prevent fixture imports; source and working-tree scans found no credential-shaped values.
surfaces.riskArea: Production test data or credential inclusion
